use_cases.name: Retail & E-commerce Customer Service
use_cases.description: Agent assists customers with retail orders (e.g., Amazon-style store) under a service policy: looking up orders, modifying or cancelling them, processing returns/exchanges, and updating account details.

workflows.name: Order lookup & status inquiry
workflows.description: Identify the user, fetch order/product details, and answer questions about order status, items, or pricing.

workflows.name: Pending order modification
workflows.description: Change items, quantities, or variants on a pending order, including price difference calculations.

workflows.name: Order cancellation
workflows.description: Cancel a pending order per policy after verifying eligibility.

workflows.name: Returns & exchanges
workflows.description: Process return of delivered order items or exchange delivered items for replacements.

workflows.name: Address & account updates
workflows.description: Modify shipping address on a pending order or update the user's saved address/profile.

workflows.name: Escalation to human agent
workflows.description: Transfer the customer to human agents when policy prohibits the agent from acting.

workflows.name: Other / unclear
workflows.description: Retail service sessions with no tool calls or ambiguous intent.

use_cases.name: Airline & Travel Customer Service
use_cases.description: Agent manages flight reservations under an airline policy: searching flights, booking, changing or cancelling reservations, checking flight status, and handling compensation.

workflows.name: Flight search & booking
workflows.description: Search direct/one-stop flights, quote prices, and book new reservations.

workflows.name: Reservation changes
workflows.description: Update reservation flights, passengers, or baggage; rebooking and seat/cabin changes.

workflows.name: Reservation cancellation & compensation
workflows.description: Cancel reservations and issue certificates or refunds where policy allows.

workflows.name: Flight status & itinerary inquiry
workflows.description: Check flight status, retrieve reservation details, and answer itinerary questions.

workflows.name: Escalation to human agent
workflows.description: Transfer to human agents for requests outside agent permissions.

workflows.name: Other / unclear
workflows.description: Airline service sessions with no tool calls or indeterminate task type.

use_cases.name: Telecom Customer Service
use_cases.description: Agent supports telecom subscribers: managing lines, roaming, data, billing, payments, and device/network configuration issues.

workflows.name: Line & roaming management
workflows.description: Enable/disable roaming, suspend/resume lines, and refuel data plans.

workflows.name: Billing & payment requests
workflows.description: Fetch bills, review charges, and send payment requests to customers.

workflows.name: Account & usage inquiry
workflows.description: Look up customers by phone/ID/name and report data usage or line details.

workflows.name: Device configuration & troubleshooting
workflows.description: Diagnose and fix device issues: APN, VPN, Wi-Fi calling, SIM status, app permissions, network mode.

workflows.name: Escalation to human agent
workflows.description: Transfer to human agents when requests exceed agent authority.

use_cases.name: Agentic Shopping & Checkout
use_cases.description: Autonomous shopping agents act on behalf of a shopper in storefront environments: discovering products, managing carts, completing checkout and payments, including delegated-payment (mandate) protocols and marketplace account operations.

workflows.name: Product search & comparison
workflows.description: Search catalogs, retrieve product details, and compare options to find matching items.

workflows.name: Cart creation & management
workflows.description: Create carts, add/update/remove lines, and apply discounts.

workflows.name: Checkout & order placement
workflows.description: Start/complete checkout, set contact and shipping details, tokenize payment, and place the order.

workflows.name: Delegated payments & mandates
workflows.description: Negotiate intent/cart/payment mandates, obtain payment credentials, and sign/execute mandates on the user's device.

workflows.name: Checkout & cart cancellation
workflows.description: Cancel checkout sessions or carts and abandon/redo purchases.

workflows.name: Marketplace account & personalization
workflows.description: Amazon-style operations: manage addresses, payment cards, wish lists, browsing history, and promo codes.

use_cases.name: Information Research & Question Answering
use_cases.description: Agents answer factual questions by searching documents or the web, expanding/retrieving sources, analyzing structured data, and submitting a structured final answer.

workflows.name: Search-based question answering
workflows.description: Iteratively search, retrieve and read documents, then submit the final answer (e.g., names, titles, facts).

workflows.name: Multi-source data extraction & analysis
workflows.description: Combine PDF extraction, SQLite queries, filesystem search, and code execution to compute an answer.

workflows.name: Other / unclear
workflows.description: Research-style tasks with minimal tool use or unclear information needs.

use_cases.name: Software Engineering & Coding Tasks
use_cases.description: Agents solve programming tasks in a computer-use/shell environment: exploring repositories, editing code, running commands, and finishing with a verified solution.

workflows.name: Shell-based programming task
workflows.description: Solve a task via iterative single bash commands with reasoning, then finish.

workflows.name: Repo exploration & multi-step implementation
workflows.description: Use file tools (read/edit/grep), task planning, and shell execution to implement or fix code.

workflows.name: Other / unclear
workflows.description: Coding sessions with no recorded tool calls or unclear objectives.

use_cases.name: Personal Productivity & App Automation
use_cases.description: Agents execute personal-assistant tasks across consumer apps on behalf of a supervisor: media playlists, notes, peer-to-peer payments, and account lookups.

workflows.name: Media & playlist management
workflows.description: Spotify operations: filter songs across playlists, create playlists, reset/shuffle/play queues.

workflows.name: Notes & personal data queries
workflows.description: Log into note apps and answer questions from personal notes (e.g., bucket list status).

workflows.name: P2P payments management
workflows.description: Review Venmo transactions and create/correct/delete payment requests.

workflows.name: Account credentials & profile lookup
workflows.description: Retrieve account passwords or profile info to support cross-app tasks.
